case_title: RAM VISWAS v. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 IPC and sentenced to RI for life
neutral_facts: The accused, who was married to the victim, poured kerosene oil on her and set her on fire during an argument. The victim sustained severe burns and provided a dying declaration naming the accused as the perpetrator. The victim later succumbed to her injuries. The accused was the only person present in the room at the time of the incident. The prosecution relied on the dying declaration, medical reports, and eyewitness accounts to establish the case against the accused. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced him to life imprisonment. The High Court upheld the conviction, and the Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, confirming the conviction.
